system_prompt:
You are a careful, neutral coder of the REALIZED OUTCOME of a corporate transaction
over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

rationale: 2-4 sentences citing the slice lines that drove your p4_pathway and
p5_pathway codes specifically. Cite ONLY realized-outcome evidence; do NOT reason
about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

# Outcome sub-dossier — LaSalle Hotel Properties realized record after merger into Pebblebrook Hotel Trust, ~3-5-year horizon

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. LaSalle Hotel Properties terminated its own SEC
> registration at closing and the acquired business was not thereafter separately
> disclosed by the surviving public registrant, so this sub-dossier documents the
> public-reporting status itself rather than a standalone realized-performance scalar.
> It contains no information about how the transaction was structured at closing.

## Public-reporting status after the transaction (feasibility-relevant)
- On December 10, 2018, a Form 15 was filed on behalf of "LaSalle Hotel Properties
  (Pebblebrook Hotel Trust as assignee of Ping Merger Sub, LLC, successor by merger to
  LaSalle Hotel Properties)" certifying termination/suspension of the duty to file
  reports under Sections 12(g), 13 and 15(d) of the Exchange Act for LaSalle's common
  shares, 6.375% Series I preferred shares, and 6.3% Series J preferred shares, each
  showing zero holders of record as of the certification date. [SRC: SEC accession 0001053532-18-000104, Form 15-12B]
- LaSalle Hotel Properties' EDGAR filing history under CIK 1053532 shows no Form 10-K
  filed after the FY2017 10-K (filed 2018-02-20, accession 0001053532-18-000006); no
  annual report covering any part of the ~2021-2023 outcome window was filed under this
  CIK. [SRC: SEC EDGAR filing index for CIK 0001053532]
- The surviving public registrant, Pebblebrook Hotel Trust (CIK 1474098), continued
  filing annual reports on Form 10-K after the merger; its Form 10-K for fiscal year 2021
  (accession 0001474098-22-000035) and its Form 10-K for fiscal year 2022 (accession
  0001474098-23-000038) contain no narrative discussion identifying "LaSalle" or the
  acquired business as a distinct, separately reported segment or operating unit — the
  hotel portfolio is reported on a combined basis. [SRC: SEC accession 0001474098-22-000035, Form 10-K FY2021] [SRC: SEC accession 0001474098-23-000038, Form 10-K FY2022]

## Items noted but not primary-verifiable as facts about the acquired business specifically
- Reputable trade press reported that Pebblebrook, at and shortly after the December
  2018 closing, began disposing of a group of hotels as part of an integration plan
  (e.g., a reported ~$821 million initial disposition), and continued portfolio-level
  hotel acquisitions and dispositions in subsequent years (e.g., a reported 2021 sale of
  the Villa Florence San Francisco and 2022 acquisitions/dispositions). [SRC: https://www.bisnow.com/national/news/hotel/pebblebrook-lasalle-merger-finalized-as-reit-sells-800m-in-hotels-95556] [SRC: https://www.globest.com/2018/12/03/pebblebrook-lasalle-complete-merger-start-selling-hotels-immediately/]
- These press reports describe portfolio-wide transactions by the combined public
  company and do not attribute specific 2021-2023 dispositions or acquisitions to
  "the LaSalle business" as opposed to the combined company's pre-existing holdings;
  they are recorded here as [UNVERIFIED] with respect to any business-specific outcome
  scalar for the acquired entity. [UNVERIFIED]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Because LaSalle Hotel Properties terminated its SEC registration effective December
  2018 and its acquired hotel business was thereafter reported only as part of the
  acquirer's combined, undifferentiated hotel portfolio with no separate segment or
  narrative disclosure in the acquirer's FY2021 or FY2022 Form 10-K, there is no public
  primary-source record of a standalone realized outcome (financial or operational) for
  the acquired business specifically within the ~2021-2023 window. [SRC: SEC accession 0001053532-18-000104, Form 15-12B] [SRC: SEC accession 0001474098-22-000035, Form 10-K FY2021] [SRC: SEC accession 0001474098-23-000038, Form 10-K FY2022]

[SLICE END]
